It proposes a specific intervention (grain boundary engineering treatment), explains its mechanism (formation of ultra-nanocrystalline near-surface layers and reduction of high-angle grain boundary energy), predicts the outcome (improved resistance to thermally induced toughness loss), and defines the conditions under which it should hold (high-temperature exposure). Additionally, C1 provides a clear falsification experiment and considers the uncertainty of the hypothesis. While other candidates also propose interventions and mechanisms, they lack the level of detail and specificity provided by C1.
